verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud's pricing and cloud pages say compute automatically scales up and down with workload and to zero when idle. Compute scales separately from storage, users can set autoscaling limits, and clusters need no manual sizing. Community complaints about scaling and coupled storage/compute refer to self-hosted clusters, so they do not contradict the managed autoscaling claim. Missing for 10: evidence that scaling happens without downtime, in-depth technical autoscaling docs beyond marketing and pricing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
